com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:read consent. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; downloads and resizes the selected image without changing listings, source files, prices or inventory.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Unowned/deleted listings, missing indexes and unsafe/unsupported images return no image. Download, decoding and size failures remain errors; request maxEdge 768 if the encoded image exceeds the budget. Missing details must not be inferred.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Use supercatch_list_store_listings for image URLs without loading pixels. Use supercatch_get_product for public offer facts. Photographs alone do not certify grade or authenticity, and this tool cannot inspect arbitrary URLs or another seller's private listing.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Return one owned listing photograph as actual MCP image content for visual inspection.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns one metadata-stripped JPEG image block plus listing ID, source URL, image count/index and actual dimensions. maxEdge defaults to 1024; 768 and 1536 are supported. Images preserve aspect ratio without cropping or enlargement.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use when identifying visible card details, checking a pictured label or comparing front/back views. Obtain listingId and image order from supercatch_list_store_listings; imageIndex defaults to zero.

imageIndex.description: Zero-based position in that listing's imageUrls. Omit for the first image; request another index for another view.

listingId.description: Owned listing ID returned by supercatch_list_store_listings; not a catalog ID or URL.

maxEdge.description: Maximum width or height in pixels. Preserves the entire image and aspect ratio, without enlargement. Request 768 if the encoded image exceeds the response budget.
